Definition: from G4314 and G5455; to sound towards, i.e. address, exclaim, summon:--call unto, speak (un-)to.
BiblicalUsage: Prosphoneo means to call unto, to sound toward, to address. Jesus called unto Him His disciples and chose twelve, He called the bent woman to Him and said, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity, and He likened His generation to children sitting in the marketplaces and calling unto their fellows.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that His calling is always personal: He called the twelve by name, He called the bent woman to Himself, and He still calls each of us by name.
